question: Which guardians are described as one-legged Anala and as having a mud-smeared body?
premises: A one-legged figure named Anala is listed.
Another figure is described as having a mud-smeared body.
Both are presented in the same enumeration.
inference: The verse lists the one-legged Anala and a guardian whose body is smeared with mud.
uncertainties: It is unclear whether the mud-smeared body describes Anala or a separate figure.
plain_english: The one-legged Anala, and indeed the one whose body is smeared with mud.
